text:
The temperature of the water at the bottom of a waterfall is greater than the temperature of the
water at the top.
The energy in the gravitational potential store of the water at the top is transferred to the thermal
store at the bottom.
The specific heat capacity of water is 4200J/(kg°C).
What is the temperature difference for a waterfall of height 21m?
0.0050°C
0.049°C
20°C
200°C
A
B
C
D
subject: Physics
